four_piece.name: Warrior Goddess of Sun and Thunder

relic_sets.notes: First-listed relic set (Hyacine.ts:562): Warrior Goddess of Sun and Thunder 4-piece (2-piece +6% SPD; 4-piece +6% SPD and +15% CRIT DMG to allies after healing another ally, once per turn).

ornament_set.name: Giant Tree of Rapt Brooding
ornament_set.notes: First-listed ornament (Hyacine.ts:570): Giant Tree of Rapt Brooding (+6% SPD; +12% Outgoing Healing at 135 SPD or more, +20% at 180 or more, wearer and memosprite; lc-text.mjs --set 320).

main_stats.notes: Fribbels options: Body CRIT DMG/HP%/Outgoing Healing Boost, Feet SPD/HP%, Sphere HP%/Wind DMG, Rope HP%. GUESS: Body Outgoing Healing Boost. Her damage is 20% of the healing tally (kit text), so healing is both her job and her damage. By rough, unchecked arithmetic OHB body (+34.56% healing) and HP% body (about +36% HP, which healing and her basic attack scale on) are close, and Fribbels' own healSimulation picks OHB. Sphere HP% over Wind DMG, GUESS, for the same reason. Feet SPD (first-listed). Rope HP% only.

spd_target.reason: Kit threshold and Fribbels hard breakpoint, both 200: her trace Tempestuous Halt gives +20% Max HP above 200 SPD and +1% Outgoing Healing per excess SPD (kit-text.mjs 1409), and Hyacine.ts:559-561 sets hardBreakpoints SPD 200 (benchmarks.md:147: missing a SPD breakpoint scores 0%). This also clears Giant Tree of Rapt Brooding's 135/180 lines (lc-text.mjs --set 320). The 180 alternative is 6 distributed rolls (180.632).

distributed.notes: Fribbels substat list: CRIT DMG, CRIT Rate, HP%, HP, SPD. GUESS: no crit rolls, because nothing in her kit text says she crits for her healing; check in-game. HP% 8 (cap: sphere and rope are HP%) and HP 10 (cap) are filled, then SPD 6. SPD: target 200 (K14e). 110 base + 14 (traces) + 6.6 (Warrior Goddess 2-piece) + 6.6 (Giant Tree 2-piece) + 25.032 + 4.6 = 166.832; 14 rolls make 199.032 (short), 15 make 201.332 (margin 1.332). The KQMS cap for SPD with SPD boots is 10, so K14e lets SPD pass it by 5 rolls; total SPD rolls 17, under the physical limit of 30. Not counted: the Warrior 4-piece's extra +6% (6.6) while "Gentle Rain" is up, which would give 207.9 in combat. Her earlier draft took 6 rolls for Giant Tree's 180 (180.632); the 200 line needs 9 more, taken from flat HP (10 down to 1) because HP% is already at its cap of 8. GUESS: that 200 rather than 180 is the target; with 180 the split would be SPD 6, HP% 8, HP 10 as before. Smitty's account shows 176 out of combat (2026-11-13; his relics are below what is achievable). Still GUESS: no crit rolls (nothing in her kit text says she crits for her healing; her E4 adds CRIT DMG per excess SPD, so check in-game). Priority: HP% 8, HP 1, then CRIT DMG and CRIT Rate from Fribbels' list (0 rolls). SPD arithmetic ignores light cone and team SPD buffs.
